tools.name: ah_invoice_get
tools.description: Get one invoice by id.

tools.name: ah_invoice_list
tools.description: List invoices (limit/skip/client/clientCompanyId).

tools.name: ah_invoice_context
tools.description: Advanced invoice context: summary, public view, linked order, related client invoices. Prefer for billing investigations.

tools.name: ah_company_members
tools.description: List company members (team/clients). Uses GET /members. Optional role/type/search filters; companyId is ignored (auth scopes workspace). For name→id resolution prefer ah_member_resolve.

companyId.description: Optional; ignored — workspace comes from API key

tools.name: ah_custom_field_list
tools.description: List workspace custom field definitions (mode=create) for lead, client, and/or task. GET /custom-fields. Use returned _ids with ah_custom_field_set_values / create lead|client customFields — never invent ids.

type.description: Optional filter; omit to return all groups

tools.name: ah_custom_field_seed_types
tools.description: List platform seed field types (text/number/boolean/…). GET /custom-fields/seed?type=customField. Usually not needed — ah_custom_field_create resolves seeds by type automatically.

tools.name: ah_whoami
tools.description: Who this API key is and what it may do: member, workspace, role, and the effective permission names. GET /accounts/whoami. Use this before a write to check authority (e.g. createService) instead of inferring it from the role name or discovering it from a 403.

tools.name: ah_member_custom_fields
tools.description: Get a lead/client member profile including custom field definitions + filled values. GET /members/:memberId. Prefer ah_member_resolve first for the id.

tools.name: ah_member_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a person name/email to a real member ObjectId from the DB (GET /members). Returns resolution=unique|ambiguous|none. If ambiguous/none: ask the user — NEVER invent or guess an id. Required before ah_work_assign / ah_order_assign when the user gave a name.

query.description: Name or email, e.g. Sara, Sara Chen, sara@agency.com

tools.name: ah_status_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a board status label (e.g. Done, In Progress) to a real TaskStatus ObjectId from GET /taskStatus. Returns unique|ambiguous|none. Never invent status ids — required before ah_work_set_status when the user gave a label.

query.description: Status label as the user said it

tools.name: ah_client_company_list
tools.description: List client companies.

tools.name: ah_client_company_get
tools.description: Get one client company.

tools.name: ah_service_list
tools.description: List catalog services. serviceType required by API: service | addOn | inline | inlineAddOn (default service).

tools.name: ah_service_get
tools.description: Get one service.

tools.name: ah_form_list
tools.description: List agency forms.

tools.name: ah_form_get
tools.description: Get one form by id.

tools.name: ah_dashboard
tools.description: Company dashboard snapshot (optional preset/from/to).

tools.name: ah_dashboard_digest
tools.description: Owner morning briefing: open invoices (unpaid), overdue tickets/tasks, recent New leads, plus raw dashboard snapshot. Prefer this over multiple list calls.

tools.name: ah_cash_risk
tools.description: Owner insight: open invoice cash at risk — aging buckets (0–7, 8–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+), total due, top clients by amount owed. Drill down with ah_invoice_context.

tools.name: ah_proposal_pipeline
tools.description: Owner insight: proposal pipeline aging — waiting-on-client, stale sent, expiring soon. Use ah_proposal_context on a row id.

tools.name: ah_lead_segments
tools.description: Owner insight: lead market segmentation by status, source, and optional lead custom field name (e.g. Industry). Lists available lead custom fields.

customFieldName.description: Optional lead custom field display name to segment on

tools.name: ah_client_churn_risk
tools.description: Owner insight: heuristic client churn risk from overdue/open invoices + quiet orders. Returns scored atRiskClients with reasons. Not ML — sample-based.

tools.name: ah_chat_list_conversations
tools.description: List in-app chat conversations. GET /chat/conversations (tab/filter/limit/cursor/search).

tools.name: ah_chat_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one chat conversation by id. GET /chat/conversations/:id

tools.name: ah_chat_list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a conversation. GET /chat/messages (pass conversationId and paging).

tools.name: ah_chat_settings
tools.description: Get chat workspace settings. GET /chat/settings

tools.name: ah_chat_context
tools.description: Context pack: conversation + recent messages + chat settings (when conversationId given).

tools.name: ah_email_to_ticket_settings
tools.description: Get email-to-ticket inbound settings (address/token/enabled). GET /company/email-to-ticket/settings

tools.name: ah_webhook_list
tools.description: List company outbound webhooks. GET /webhooks

tools.name: ah_webhook_get
tools.description: Get one webhook by id. GET /webhooks/:webhookId

tools.name: ah_webhook_events
tools.description: List available webhook event types. GET /webhooks/events/list

tools.name: ah_webhook_logs
tools.description: List webhook delivery logs. GET /webhooks/logs (optional webhookId, limit, skip).

tools.name: ah_webhook_context
tools.description: Context pack: webhook details + recent logs + event catalog.

tools.name: ah_order_subscription_list
tools.description: List client order-subscriptions (recurring). GET /order-subscriptions?client=&clientCompanyId=

tools.name: ah_order_subscription_get
tools.description: Get one order-subscription. GET /order-subscriptions/:subscriptionId

tools.name: ah_platform_subscription_list
tools.description: List Agency Handy SaaS subscriptions for the workspace. GET /subscriptions/list

tools.name: ah_lead_create
tools.description: Create one or more leads. POST /members/bulk-lead (body = array). Required: email, status (New|Contacted|Qualified|Working|Proposal Sent|Negotiation), type (individual|leadCompanyMember). Defaults: type=individual, status=New, sendInvitationEmail=false.

leads.description: Optional bulk array; if set, top-level fields are ignored

_id.description: Custom field definition ObjectId from ah_custom_field_list

customFields.description: Optional values using definition ids from ah_custom_field_list (type=lead)

tools.name: ah_client_create
tools.description: Create one or more clients (people). POST /members/bulk-client (body = array). status is always Client. Email optional. Converts existing lead with same email. Default sendInvitationEmail=true.

clients.description: Optional bulk array; if set, top-level fields are ignored

_id.description: Custom field definition ObjectId from ah_custom_field_list

customFields.description: Optional values using definition ids from ah_custom_field_list (type=client)

tools.name: ah_client_company_create
tools.description: Create a client company (B2B). POST /client-companies. Required: name, ownerId (existing member), city. type is always client.

tools.name: ah_member_update
tools.description: Update a lead or client profile. PUT /accounts/update. Pass accountId plus any fields to change (name, status, contact, agent, etc.).

_id.description: Custom field definition ObjectId from ah_custom_field_list

leadCustomFields.description: Set lead custom field values (definition _id + typed value)

_id.description: Custom field definition ObjectId from ah_custom_field_list

clientCustomFields.description: Set client custom field values (definition _id + typed value)

tools.name: ah_lead_convert
tools.description: Convert a lead to a client. PUT /accounts/update with isConvertedClient=true (same endpoint as member update).

tools.name: ah_client_invite
tools.description: Email portal invite(s) to existing client(s). POST /members/send-client-invite with clientIds[].

tools.name: ah_ticket_create
tools.description: Create a ticket (task with type=issue). POST /tasks. Required: name, priority, labels[], type=issue. client required unless visibility=internal|order.

labels.description: Label ObjectIds (required by API; empty array ok)

tools.name: ah_ticket_update
tools.description: Update a ticket. PUT /tasks/:taskId. Use for name, status, priority, dates, description.

tools.name: ah_task_create
tools.description: Create a task (type=task). POST /tasks. Required: name, priority, labels[]. client required unless visibility=internal|order.

labels.description: Label ObjectIds (required by API; empty array ok)

tools.name: ah_task_update
tools.description: Update a task. PUT /tasks/:taskId.

tools.name: ah_comment_create
tools.description: Add a comment on a ticket/task. POST /comments. Required: text, taskId, type (default agencyComment). memberId defaults to API key owner.

memberId.description: Author member ObjectId (defaults to API key member)

tools.name: ah_invoice_create
tools.description: Create an invoice. POST /invoices. Required: currency and one of client | externalEmail | clientCompanyId. Use additionalFields for line items when amount>0.

tools.name: ah_invoice_update
tools.description: Update an invoice. PUT /invoices/:invoiceId. Common: status, notes, dueDate, amount fields.

tools.name: ah_proposal_create
tools.description: Create a proposal/quotation. POST /quotations. Provide clientId or leadId or externalEmail (+ names). Optional: name, budget, currency, status, inlineServices[].

inlineServices.description: Service line payloads as accepted by createQuotation

tools.name: ah_proposal_update
tools.description: Update a proposal. PUT /quotations/:quotationId.

tools.name: ah_proposal_send
tools.description: Send a proposal to the recipient. PUT /quotations/send/:quotationId.

tools.name: ah_order_update
tools.description: Update an order/project. PUT /orders?pid=. Fields: name, status, deadline, budget, notes, brief, kickoffDate, assignedProjectManagers[].

tools.name: ah_invoice_send
tools.description: Send an invoice to the client. Draft → sets status open (emails client). Already open → resend via PUT /invoices/resend. Pass resend=true to force resend.

resend.description: Force resend path even for a single id

tools.name: ah_invoice_set_status
tools.description: Set invoice status (paid|void|open|uncollectable|draft). PUT /invoices/:invoiceId. Prefer ah_invoice_send to email a draft.

tools.name: ah_order_create
tools.description: Create an order from a catalog service package. POST /orders/create. Required: name, budget, currency, service, packageId, packageName, clientId (or company target). Defaults: quantity=1, paymentType=oneTime, createInvoice=false, clientTargetType=individual. Prefer ah_service_list/get first for package ids.

serviceFee.description: Defaults to { name: packageName, amount: budget, quantity }

tools.name: ah_work_assign
tools.description: Add or remove assignees on a ticket or task. Pass memberIds from ah_member_resolve only (resolution=unique or user-confirmed match). NEVER invent ids or resolve names yourself. action=add → POST /tasks/member/:taskId; action=remove → PUT.

memberId.description: Shorthand for a single memberId from ah_member_resolve

tools.name: ah_order_assign
tools.description: Set order project managers. Pass assignedProjectManagers / memberId from ah_member_resolve only (unique or user-confirmed). NEVER invent ids. PUT /orders?pid=.

tools.name: ah_work_set_status
tools.description: Move a ticket/task to a board status. Pass status ObjectId from ah_status_resolve (unique or user-confirmed) or ah_task_statuses. NEVER invent status ids or map labels yourself.

tools.name: ah_custom_field_create
tools.description: Create a lead/client/task custom field definition in Workspace Config. Resolves seed type id automatically. POST /custom-fields?type=. Admin/SuperAdmin only. Prefer ah_custom_field_list afterward for the definition _id used in set_values.

type.description: text | number | boolean | singleSelect | multiSelect | file

fields.description: Optional bulk: [{ name, type, required?, options? }]

tools.name: ah_custom_field_set_values
tools.description: Fill lead or client custom field values on a member. POST /custom-fields/respond?type=. Pass definition _ids from ah_custom_field_list (or respond-mode ids from ah_member_custom_fields). Never invent field ids.

type.description: Must match the field owner (lead vs client)

_id.description: Custom field definition ObjectId from ah_custom_field_list

tools.name: ah_service_create
tools.description: Create a catalog service. POST /services. Requires the createService permission — check with ah_whoami first rather than discovering it from a rejection. Required: name, serviceType, type, isPublished, packages (1-5, each with price + currency, unique packageName and position). reminderType/reminders are accepted only when type=subscription; files/mediaPositions only when serviceType=service.

packages.description: packageName and position must be unique within the service

tools.name: ah_service_update
tools.description: Update a catalog service, changing only what you pass. PUT /services/:id requires the complete service and package array, so this reads the service first and merges your changes into it — omitting a field keeps its current value, and omitting a package keeps that package. Match a package by packageId (preferred) or packageName. Use removePackages to drop one deliberately. Requires the updateService permission (check with ah_whoami).

packages.description: Partial package changes. Each entry needs packageId or packageName to identify an existing package; an entry matching nothing is created.

removePackages.description: packageId or packageName of packages to delete

tools.name: ah_custom_field_delete
tools.description: Delete custom field definition(s). DELETE /custom-fields. Admin/SuperAdmin only. Pass ids from ah_custom_field_list.

tools.name: ah_get_invoice
tools.description: Alias of ah_invoice_get.
